description: A warmly characterful farmhouse kitchen bathed in bright morning light. The shiplap ceiling is painted crisp white, intersected by a thick hand-hewn reclaimed wood beam running horizontally just above the island zone. The walls are painted white with a white-painted brick subway tile backsplash behind a large professional-grade stainless steel range with pot filler. Perimeter cabinetry is all-white shaker style with simple hardware. The large central kitchen island features a dark walnut-stained base with raised panel detailing and a thick white marble top veined in grey — on it a wooden cutting board holds fresh-baked croissants, a white ceramic pitcher holds a branch of green foliage, and a single faucet serves an integrated sink. Three black Windsor-style stools with spindle backs tuck under the island's overhang. To the left, a pair of warm wood French doors with cross-pattern divided glazing opens to the outside, flooding the left side of the kitchen with natural light. The floor is wide-plank light oak with visible grain. Warm amber glows descend from above the island, casting golden pools of light onto the marble surface.
